# BBSServerModelBlock

*Server* · extends [`ScriptServerBlockEntity`](/scripting/server/block/ScriptServerBlockEntity)

Live BBS model block obtained with `world.getModelBlock(x, y, z)`. Setters validate, save and synchronize immediately on the server game thread; no explicit save is needed. Unloaded, replaced or removed handles throw IllegalStateException. Forms, transforms, equipment and NBT are copied. Settings updates use BBS's normal block-entity synchronization, which restarts client form animations. The estimated block NBT size is limited to 1 MiB, depth to 512, and keys/strings to 65535 modified UTF-8 bytes. Script edits do not acquire the BBS editor's pending settings.

```js
var block = c.getWorld().getModelBlock(0, 64, 0);
if (block !== null) {
    block.setForm(scram.form("{\"id\":\"bbs:mob\",\"mobId\":\"minecraft:pig\"}"));
    block.setRotation(0, 90, 0).setScale(2).setEnabled(true);
}
```
